findings.detail: Locale reflected X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP / Forwarded as the client IP
findings.reason: Compose/CI callers sit on loopback or RFC1918, which default _APP_TRUSTED_PROXIES treats as a proxy. Locale then reflects X-Forwarded-For. Not an untrusted-Internet spoof; revisit if trusted-proxy defaults are narrowed.
